أصطلي (form VIII)
# أَصْطَلِي (ʔaṣṭalī) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.liː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
# أَصْطَلِيَ (ʔaṣṭaliya) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.li.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
